{{Infobox character|name=Reverend Torvald|image=Portrait torvald.jpg|house=[[House Stonebear]]|role=Head of house; oath-witness|age=~59|kin=[[Rurik Stonebear]] (son)|words=A word is the only stone that holds.|seat=[[Oath-hold]]}}
'''Reverend Torvald Stonebear''' is the realm's most sought-after oath-witness — and a man entirely at peace with what his word costs. Asked to bend a word, he falls silent and grips something solid: stone, a table's edge, a wall. Not from dread. From settlement.

He keeps the rite at the Wall of Shame's nameless line, as his line has always kept it, and does not ask whose name is missing.
